title: Inviting delight in the unboxing experience
summary: Concept work bringing delight into the Procter & Gamble unboxing experience.

sections.label: OVERVIEW
sections.title: How might we invite delight into the unboxing moment?
sections.body: Explored packaging and first-open experiences that feel considered, brand-forward, and easy to navigate.

sections.label: PROBLEM
sections.title: Unboxing felt transactional instead of memorable.
sections.body: The first physical touchpoint with the product carried little emotional payoff or guided discovery.

sections.label: SOLUTION
sections.title: A sequenced unboxing narrative with tactile delight.
sections.body: Concepted layers, reveals, and micro-moments that make opening the package feel intentional.

sections.label: OUTCOME
sections.title: A direction ready for stakeholder review.
sections.body: Delivered concept explorations and a clear story for how delight can live in the unboxing flow.
